title: Moving to Naples, FL: The 2026 Relocation Guide for Northeast and Midwest Buyers
excerpt: Collier County's median closed price was $575,000 in August 2026 with inventory down 20.7% and supply at 5.4 months — but the figure that may matter most to an out-of-state buyer this year is a date: December 31, 2026, the Amendment 3 residency deadline that could decide your homestead exemption for four years.
